Daxamur 出色的工作流程

注释

我已尽力将您想要配置的大多数节点（大致）按顺序放置在流程的下部，而大多数操作/后端内容位于顶部。节点已根据其功能尽可能清晰地标记。

除此之外；

  • 默认情况下，采样器和调度程序设置为 euler_ancestral // sgm_uniform，因为在我的整个测试过程中，我发现这种组合最常为我提供最佳结果。我确实计划在此流程中的配置块中添加一些节点，以便轻松地在所有采样节点上设置采样器和调度程序，但由于某种原因，允许这样做的节点并不总是运行良好 - 我可能会创建自己的节点，我们会看到。

  • 默认情况下，此流程会将完成的视频保存到 ComfyUI/output/Illustrious/。

  • 此流程在设计时考虑了高 VRAM，但如果需要，我可以发布低 VRAM 版本。

  • 如果需要，还包含一个简单的旁路器，可用于跳过细节/放大通道。

  • 我强烈建议您设置 pysssss booru 标签文本自动完成器，因为它可以更好地编写基于标签的提示。我使用的自定义单词列表是：https://gist.githubusercontent.com/pythongosssss/1d3efa6050356a08cea975183088159a/raw/a18fb2f94f9156cf4476b0c24a09544d6c0baec6/danbooru-tags.txt

o.en:
Daxamur's Illustrious Workflow

Notes

I've done my best to place most nodes that you'd want to configure at the lower portion of the flow (roughly) sequentially, while most of the operational / backend stuff sits at the top. Nodes have been labeled according to their function as clearly as possible.

Beyond that;

  • The sampler and scheduler are set to euler_ancestral // sgm_uniform by default as throughout my testing I have found this combination gives me the best results, most often. I do plan to add some nodes to the config block in this flow for easily setting the sampler and schedulers across all sampling nodes, but for some reason the nodes that allow this don't always play nicely - I may create my own, we'll see.

  • This flow will save finished videos to ComfyUI/output/Illustrious/ by default.

  • This flow was designed with high VRAM in mind, but I can release a low VRAM version if the need arises.

  • An easy bypasser is included for use in skipping detailing / upscaling passes if desired.

  • I highly recommend that you set up the pysssss booru tag Text AutoCompleter, as it makes writing tag based prompts much much better. The custom words list I use is:https://gist.githubusercontent.com/pythongosssss/1d3efa6050356a08cea975183088159a/raw/a18fb2f94f9156cf4476b0c24a09544d6c0baec6/danbooru-tags.txt
